paragraphs: We are a leading provider of outdoor lifestyle products and shooting sports accessories encompassing hunting, fishing, meat processing, outdoor cooking, shooting, and personal security and defense products for rugged outdoor enthusiasts.
We conceive, design, produce or source, and sell our outdoor lifestyle products, including:
•premium sportsman knives and tools for fishing and hunting; •land management tools for hunting preparedness and for use in the backyard;
•products used while hunting; •meat processing equipment; and
We conceive, design, produce or source, and sell our shooting sports accessories, including:
•rests, vaults, and other related accessories;
•electro-optical devices, including hunting optics, firearm aiming devices, flashlights, and laser grips;
•and reloading, gunsmithing, and firearm cleaning supplies.

We focus on our brands and the establishment of product categories in which we believe our brands will resonate strongly with the activities and passions of consumers and enable us to capture an increasing share of our overall addressable markets. Our owned brands include BOG, BUBBA, Caldwell, Crimson Trace, Frankford Arsenal, Grilla, Hooyman, Imperial, LaserLyte, Lockdown, MEAT! Your Maker, Old Timer, Schrade, Tipton, Uncle Henry, and Wheeler, and we license additional brands for use in association with certain products we sell, including M&P, Smith & Wesson, and Performance Center by Smith & Wesson. In focusing on the growth of our brands, we organize our product development, customer service, and marketing teams into four brand lanes, each of which focuses on one of four distinct consumer verticals – Adventurer, Harvester, Marksman, and Defender – with each of our brands included in one of the brand lanes. Our brand lane structure allows us to efficiently leverage talent, expertise, and resources across multiple brands while maintaining a strong focus on the unique needs of each consumer vertical. This approach provides the benefits of dedicated brand support in a more scalable and cost-effective manner than maintaining separate teams for every individual brand.

Our sales activities are focused on how we go to market within the e-commerce and traditional distribution channels. These two channels involve distinct strategies intended to increase revenue and enhance market share by placing our products where the consumer expects to find them. Our sales team is built around the two distribution channels and is organized into product categories and regions within the e-commerce and traditional channels and sells our products across all of our brands. We measure our success through sales performance in these distribution channels against prior results and our own expectations.

Our objective is to enhance our position as a leading provider of high-quality and innovative outdoor lifestyle products and shooting sports accessories for the hunting, fishing, outdoor cooking, shooting, personal security and defense, and other rugged outdoor markets and to expand our addressable market into carefully selected new product arenas.
Key elements of our strategy to achieve this objective and deliver long-term stockholder value are as follows:
•introduce a continuing stream of innovative new and differentiated rugged outdoor products and product extensions that appeal to consumers;
•leverage our innovation advantage to gain market share, enter new product categories, enter new consumer markets, and expand distribution;

headings: Risks Related to Our Common Stock
We are dependent on the proper functioning of our critical facilities, our supply chain, and distribution networks as well as the financial stability of our customers.
We must continue to introduce new products that are successful in the marketplace.
We rely to a significant extent on outsourcing for a substantial portion of our production, and any interruptions in these arrangements could disrupt our ability to fill our customers' orders.
Fluctuations in the costs and availability of finished products, components, and raw materials could affect our business and operating results.
We often rely on third parties, including product sourcing intermediaries, independent sales representatives and agents, that act on our behalf.
Our operating results could be materially harmed if we are unable to forecast demand for our products accurately.
An inability to expand our e-commerce business could reduce our future growth.
We compete in highly competitive markets with numerous large and small competitors and with limited barriers to entry.
A substantial portion of our revenue depends on a small number of large customers.
Retail pricing decisions made by certain of our customers could negatively impact the pricing for our products in certain online marketplaces.
Changes in the retail industry and the markets for consumer products could negatively impact existing customer relationships and our operating results.
We may have difficulty collecting amounts owed to us.
We are subject to payment-related risks.
Our performance is influenced by a variety of economic, social, political, legislative, and regulatory factors.
Our revenue and profits depend upon the level of consumer spending, which is sensitive to global economic conditions and other factors.
We depend on our Missouri facility, which may not produce the benefits expected.
Our business is subject to the risk of earthquakes, fire, power outages, floods, and other catastrophic events.
Our business is subject to the risk of terrorism, cyberattacks, or failure of key information technology systems.
Acquisitions involve significant risks, and we may not be able to complete acquisitions that we desire to make in the future.
Seasonality, weather conditions, and periodic fluctuations, such as changes in customer ordering patterns, may cause our operating results to vary from quarter to quarter.
Our growth strategy may require significant additional funds, the amount of which will depend upon our working capital and general corporate needs.
We may issue a substantial amount of our common stock in the future, which could cause dilution to current investors and otherwise adversely affect our stock price.
The failure to manage our growth could adversely affect our operations.
paragraphs: Investors should carefully consider the following risk factors, together with all the other information included in the Form 10-K, in evaluating our company, our business, and our prospects. The most significant risks that could materially and adversely affect our business operations, financial condition, and cash flows include the risk factors described below.

These disclosures reflect our beliefs and opinions as to factors that could materially and adversely affect us and our securities in the future. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not such factors have occurred in the past or their likelihood of occurring in the future.
We have summarized our risk factors as follows:
•We are dependent on the proper functioning of our critical facilities, our supply chain, and distribution networks as well as the financial stability of our customers.
•We must continue to introduce new products that are successful in the marketplace.
•We rely to a significant extent on outsourcing for a substantial portion of our production, and any interruptions in these arrangements could disrupt our ability to fill our customers' orders.

paragraphs: Our operating results for fiscal 2026 included the following:
•Net sales were $190.5 million, a decrease of $31.8 million, or 14.3%, from the prior fiscal year.
•Gross margin was 44.7%, an increase of 10 basis points over the prior fiscal year.
•Net loss was $9.2 million, or $(0.73) per diluted share, compared with a net loss of $77,000, or $(0.01) per diluted share, for the prior fiscal year.

•Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA was $10.2 million, compared with $17.7 million for the prior fiscal year. See non-GAAP financial measure disclosures below for our reconciliation of Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA.
•We repurchased a total of 551,283 shares of our common stock, in the open market, for $5.1M during fiscal 2026.

paragraphs: 本公司為外圍戶外生活方式產品及射擊運動配件的領導供應商，產品包括為嚴峻戶外愛好者提供的狩獵、釣魚、肉類加工、戶外烹飪、射擊及個人安全防衛產品。
本公司規劃、設計、製造或來源，並銷售外圍生活方式產品，包括：
• 高端運動用刀具及工具，用於釣魚及狩獵；• 獵前準備及用於後院的陸地管理工具；
• 獵時使用的產品；• 肉類加工設備；以及
本公司規劃、設計、製造或來源，並銷售我們的射擊運動配件，包括：
• rests、vaults 及其他相關配件；
• 電光學設備，包括狩獵光學、槍械瞄準裝置、手電筒及雷射握把；
• 以及裝填、槍匠工具及槍械清潔用品。

我們著重於我們的品牌與產品類別的建立，我們相信這些品牌會與消費者的活動與熱情產生強烈共鳴，並使我們能佔據我們總體可接觸市場的更大份額。我們的自有品牌包括 BOG、BUBBA、Caldwell、Crimson Trace、Frankford Arsenal、Grilla、Hooyman、Imperial、LaserLyte、Lockdown、MEAT! Your Maker、Old Timer、Schrade、Tipton、Uncle Henry 和 Wheeler，我們也授權使用其他品牌於特定產品上，包括 M&P、Smith & Wesson 和 Performance Center by Smith & Wesson。在專注於品牌成長的同時，我們將產品開發、客戶服務與行銷團隊組織為四條品牌線，每條線專注於四個不同的消費者垂直領域 – 戶外冒險者、獵人、射手與防衛者 – 我們的每個品牌皆歸屬於其中一條品牌線。我們的品牌線結構使我們能有效地在多個品牌間運用人才、專業知識與資源，同時維持對每個消費者垂直領域獨特需求的強烈關注。這種方式提供了比為每個個別品牌維持獨立團隊更可擴展且更具成本效益的專注品牌支援優勢。
我們的銷售活動著重於我們如何透過電商與傳統通路進行市場推廣。這兩個通路涉及不同的策略，旨在增加營收與提升市場佔有率，將產品放置在消費者預期會找到的地方。我們的銷售團隊是根據這兩個通路建立的，並在電商與傳統通路內按產品類別與地區進行組織，銷售我們所有品牌的產品。我們透過這些通路的銷售表現與過去結果及我們自身的預期進行比較，來衡量我們的成功。
我們的目標是強化我們作為高品質與創新戶外生活方式產品與射擊運動配件的領導供應商地位，服務狩獵、釣魚、戶外烹飪、射擊、個人安全與防衛，以及其他堅固戶外市場，並擴展我們的可接觸市場至經過仔細選擇的新產品領域。
我們實現此目標並為長期股東創造價值的策略關鍵要素如下：
•持續推出創新且差異化的堅固戶外產品與產品延伸，以吸引消費者；
•運用我們的創新優勢來爭取市場佔有率、進入新產品類別、進入新消費者市場，並擴大通路。

paragraphs: 本公司 10-K 會計年度 2026 年的營運結果包含以下項目：
•淨銷售額為 190.5 百萬美元，較前一會計年度減少 31.8 百萬美元，或 14.3%。
•毛利率為 44.7%，較前一會計年度增加 10 基點。
•淨虧損為 9.2 百萬美元，或每股稀釋後普通股為 $(0.73)，與前一會計年度淨虧損為 77,000 美元，或每股稀釋後普通股為 $(0.01) 相較。
•非 GAAP 調整後 EBITDA 為 10.2 百萬美元，與前一會計年度的 17.7 百萬美元相較。請參閱下方非 GAAP 財務指標揭露部分，以瞭解我們對非 GAAP 調整後 EBITDA 的重新計算。
•本公司於 10-K 會計年度 2026 年於公開市場購回總計 551,283 股本公司普通股，總金額為 5.1 百萬美元。

headings: 與本公司業務相關之風險
與本公司普通股相關之風險
我們依賴關鍵設施、供應鏈及配送網路之正常運作，以及客戶之財務穩定性。
我們必須持續推出市場上成功的產品。
我們在生產過程之大部分依賴委外合作，若這些合作關係中斷，可能影響我們履行客戶訂單之能力。
成品、零組件及原材料之成本與供應量波動，可能影響我們之業務與營運成果。
我們常依賴第三方，包括產品來源中介、獨立銷售代表及代理商，代表我們行事。
若我們無法準確預測產品之需求，可能導致我們之營運成果受到重大影響。
無法擴展我們的電商業務可能會降低我們未來的成長。
我們在高度競爭的市場中競爭，競爭對手包括許多大型和小型企業，且市場進入門檻有限。
我們營業收入的相當大一部分依賴少數大型客戶。
部分客戶所做出的零售價格決定可能會對我們產品在某些線上市場的價格造成負面影響。
零售業及消費性產品市場的變化可能會對現有客戶關係及我們的營運成果造成負面影響。
我們可能難以收回應收帳款。
我們面臨與付款相關的風險。
我們的營運表現受到多種經濟、社會、政治、立法及法規因素的影響。
本公司營業收入及獲利取決於消費者支出水準，而消費者支出易受全球經濟條件及其他因素影響。
本公司依賴密蘇裏州廠區，該廠區可能無法產生預期效益。
本公司業務面臨地震、火災、停電、洪水及其他災難性事件的風險。
本公司業務面臨恐怖主義、網路攻擊或關鍵資訊科技系統失敗的風險。
併購行為涉及重大風險，本公司可能無法完成未來所希望進行的併購。
季節性、天氣條件及週期性波動，例如客戶訂單模式的變化，可能導致本公司營運成果於各季度間有所差異。
本公司成長策略可能需要大量額外資金，所需金額將取決於本公司營運資金及一般企業需求。
本公司未來可能發行大量普通股，此舉可能對現有投資人造成稀釋，並對本公司股票價格產生其他不利影響。
